services.name: Bus Tours
services.desc: Hit the Road Educational Tours are a fun way to explore regional travel destinations and support the Friends of Fort Hunter. Over the years, these bus trips have visited the homes of multiple United States Presidents, attended live theatre performances, explored famous museums, and so much more! Each trip is thoughtfully curated by Dr. Don Koones and his wife, Marilyn, and feature thrilling lectures and unique dining experiences. services.name: Barn Rentals
services.desc: The Centennial Barn, built in 1876, is a unique rental facility that provides a beautiful and historic setting for any gathering. The barn has been updated with modern conveniences, including two rooms of different sizes, a fully equipped kitchen, restrooms and heating/air conditioning, while still maintaining its historical ambiance. Whether you are planning a small, intimate gathering or a larger event, the Centennial Barn offers a unique and charming atmosphere. In addition to the two first-floor rooms, the Centennial Barn offers restrooms located in the lobby between the two rooms, which serve the entire building. services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Fort Hunter Park offers two beautiful picnic pavilions for visitors to enjoy. These pavilions are the perfect place for a family picnic or barbecue, with plenty of space and convenient amenities such as public restrooms and parking. The pavilions can be reserved in advance or used on a first-come, first-served basis. One pavilion is located on the west side of Front Street, near the Susquehanna River, while the other is on the east side of Front Street, near the Centennial Barn. In addition to the picnic pavilions, Fort Hunter Park also offers a variety of other amenities to make a visit even more enjoyable.
